title: Quantum Random Number Generator (QRNG)
visual_bloch_desc: The Bloch sphere is a geometric representation of the quantum state of a qubit. It provides an intuitive way to visualize the superposition and entanglement of qubits. In particular, in the visualization below you can see how the selected Qubits have been put into superposition.
visual_transition_desc: The evolution of a quantum state is a fundamental concept in quantum mechanics. It describes how the state of a quantum system changes over time. In the visualization below, you can observe the evolution of the quantum state of the Qubit by applying the Hadamard gate to the initial state.
key_desc:
Here is the key generated after measuring the qubits.
Each bit is the result of quantum collapse after superposition.
datagram_desc:
In computing and telecommunications, it is common to divide data into bit packets called **datagrams**.
Here, we group the bits into **4-bit** blocks to facilitate conversion into decimal numbers.
decimal_desc:
Each **4-bit** block is converted into a decimal number, forming the final key.
This allows numbers to be represented more compactly and usefully in cryptographic applications.
